@graph.name: Zermatt Lodge | 4-Bed House to Rent in Liverpool, Sleeps 7
@graph.description: Entire 4-bed, 2-bath house in Fazakerley, north Liverpool. Sleeps 7, games room, garden, free parking for 2 cars. Near Aintree Hospital. Book direct.

mainEntity.name: How many people does Zermatt Lodge sleep?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zermatt Lodge sleeps up to 7 guests. It is an entire 4-bedroom house with 4 beds: a king in the master bedroom (with en-suite), a second king, a queen and a single.

mainEntity.name: How many bedrooms and bathrooms are there?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The king master bedroom has its own en-suite, and there is a second bathroom for the other three bedrooms.

mainEntity.name: Is it the entire house or a shared space?

acceptedAnswer.text: You get the entire house to yourselves - all four bedrooms, both bathrooms, the kitchen, dining room, games room and the large private back garden. Nothing is shared with other guests.

mainEntity.name: Where is Zermatt Lodge?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zermatt Lodge is in Fazakerley, north Liverpool, Merseyside. It is close to Aintree University Hospital, The Walton Centre, Aintree Racecourse, Fazakerley station and the M57 and M58. The full address is sent to confirmed guests.

mainEntity.name: Is it close to Aintree University Hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Aintree University Hospital is about 0.6 miles away in a straight line, in Fazakerley. It is a good base for patients' families, visitors and NHS staff who want a whole house with free parking.

mainEntity.name: How far is it from The Walton Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Walton Centre shares the Aintree University Hospital site on Lower Lane, Fazakerley, so it is about 0.6 miles away in a straight line. Fazakerley station is the closest station to the hospital site.

mainEntity.name: Is there parking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there is free parking for 2 cars at the house. That is useful for hospital visits, as parking on the Aintree hospital site is chargeable.

mainEntity.name: How do I get to Liverpool city centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fazakerley station is on the Merseyrail Northern line, with trains to Liverpool Central taking about 15 minutes. You can tap in and out with a contactless card or phone. By car, the city centre is about 4.5 miles away.

mainEntity.name: Is it good for the Grand National?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Aintree Racecourse is very close, and Aintree station runs extra trains on race days. The 2027 Grand National Festival runs 8-10 April 2027, so book early as it is the busiest week of the year.

mainEntity.name: Is it close to Anfield and Everton's stadium?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anfield is about 3 miles away. Everton's Hill Dickinson Stadium at Bramley-Moore Dock is about 4 miles away - take the train from Fazakerley to Sandhills (around 8 minutes) and walk from there.

mainEntity.name: What time are check-in and check-out?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check-in is from 3pm and check-out is by 11am.

mainEntity.name: Is the house suitable for contractors and work crews?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It sleeps 7 across 4 bedrooms, has free parking for 2 cars, a big kitchen and a dining room, and is close to the M57 and M58 for getting around Merseyside and the North West.

mainEntity.name: Is it good for families and groups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. There is a games room with a pool table, board games, a 55" Smart TV with Netflix, a big kitchen, a separate dining room and a large private back garden.

mainEntity.name: What entertainment is there?

acceptedAnswer.text: The games room has a pool table, there are board games for all ages, and the living area has a 55" Smart TV with Netflix.

mainEntity.name: Can we have a party or event?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Parties and events are not allowed at Zermatt Lodge.

mainEntity.name: Is smoking allowed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Smoking is not allowed anywhere in the house.

mainEntity.name: Are pets allowed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, pets are not allowed.

mainEntity.name: What do I need to provide before my stay?

acceptedAnswer.text: All guests booking need to provide ID, sign a rental agreement, and either pay a damage deposit or take the damage waiver. We will ask for these after you book.

mainEntity.name: How do I book?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can book directly on this website - choose your dates in the booking section and pay securely by card. Booking direct means you deal with the host, ZALO Stays, from start to finish.

mainEntity.name: Who runs Zermatt Lodge?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zermatt Lodge is run by ZALO Stays. You can call +44 7479 905477 or email eli@zelr.co.uk.

mainEntity.name: Are there shops nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lidl, Tesco Express and Co-op are on Longmoor Lane in Fazakerley, close to the house.

mainEntity.name: How far is Liverpool John Lennon Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Liverpool John Lennon Airport is about 10 miles away in a straight line. Most guests drive or take a taxi; by public transport you can go via the city centre.

mainEntity.name: Are there parks nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Walton Hall Park has 130 acres and two lakes, and Croxteth Hall and Country Park, about 2.5 miles away, has a working farm, a walled garden and a free Saturday parkrun.
